policy: Duplicates are classified, not automatically consolidated. Rule 7 forbids copying business logic, and the brief forbids redesigning pricing, booking, payment or settlement.

duplicates.current_callers: CampaignPricingEngine is the campaign path; PricingEngine/PricingRuleEngine serve /v2/pricing/calculate and the minute-pricing screens.
duplicates.behavior_difference: Different scopes: campaign multi-asset aggregation versus per-screen/per-duration rule evaluation.
duplicates.financial_difference: Both are live. Campaign booking golden suites pin CampaignPricingEngine arithmetic; PricingEngine is pinned by MinutePricingEngineTest.
duplicates.migration_risk: HIGH - consolidating two live pricing engines risks changing campaign pricing arithmetic.

duplicates.current_callers: BookingCapacityService by RescheduleBookingUseCase; InventoryService by CreateCampaignBookingUseCase.
duplicates.behavior_difference: Deliberate separation: an availability CHECK is not a transactional inventory LOCK.
duplicates.financial_difference: InventoryService holds the row lock; the brief requires lockForUpdate stays inside the transaction.
duplicates.migration_risk: HIGH - merging them would move lock semantics.
duplicates.note: This is the distinction section 0.18.5 explicitly requires preserving.

duplicates.behavior_difference: Campaign derives authoritative amounts from CampaignPricingService; manual booking is a multi-channel flow with its own finance/audit/commission side effects.
duplicates.note: Carried forward unchanged from the Phase 0.13 decision.
